summary: Full-stack validation of the new Frasberg Motion video presets, Gallery Videos tab, VideoShare /v/:id page, and GET /api/videos endpoints. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_videos_api.py covering auth (401 without token), listing (newest-first, correct shape, both seed videos present with id/prompt/style/duration/engine/model/mode/aspect_ratio/url=/api/media/{id}/created_at), mode mapping (image-to-video for 9:16 Motion Pro and text-to-video for 16:9 Lite), legacy engine label (luchii-local -> 'Frasberg Lite (CPU)'), public GET /api/videos/{id} for both seeds, 404 on unknown id, and /api/media/{id} returning video bytes. Frontend /video: Trending row shows all 8 presets (surprise, pov, glowup, satisfying, pet, dance, food, outfit); tapping POV filled the prompt (162 chars) and highlighted 9:16; six Surprise-me taps produced 5 distinct prompts (never duplicates with current prompt); Quick preset row also visible. Attaching a start image hid the Trending and Quick rows and showed the Photo motion row with all 8 motion presets (zoom-in, orbit, hair-wind, come-alive, dolly-out, parallax, slowmo, rain-glow); tapping zoom-in filled the motion description; removing the image restored Trending and Quick and hid Photo motion. Public /v/eff23281... loaded video-share-page + player with meta 'Photo-to-video · 5s · 9:16 · by Motion Tester' and the badge 'Made with Frasberg Motion Pro · Powered by Frasberg'; replay/copy/download/cta buttons all present; download href points to /api/media/{id} with the download attribute set to 'frasberg-motion-eff23281.mp4'; cta href = /video. Public /v/cfde8c3d... showed 'Made with Frasberg Lite (CPU)' and meta 'Text-to-video · 5s · 16:9'. Unknown id -> video-share-error. Gallery /gallery after login (motion.tester) rendered gallery-tab-videos; Videos tab listed both seed cards with player, replay, share, download, open buttons; 'Photo → video' and 'Text → video' badges present; engine labels 'Frasberg Motion Pro' and 'Frasberg Lite (CPU)' shown; download href=/api/media/{id} with download attr, open href=/v/{id}; share button triggered the share handler (clipboard blocked in headless -> fell back to toast.message with the URL, which is the documented fallback behaviour); images/takes/models tabs still clickable and render as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: shareVideo() in Studio.jsx silently falls back to toast.message(url) when both navigator.share and navigator.clipboard are unavailable; this shows the raw URL instead of a 'Share link copied!' confirmation. Consider showing a toast like 'Copy this link: ...' or an action button to copy via a textarea fallback for better UX.

video_card() uses j.get('has_image') to infer image-to-video mode; the GPU gateway may complete a job without the has_image flag persisted if the fallback path strips it. Consider storing an explicit 'mode' on the job doc to avoid ambiguity.

VideoShare.jsx uses axios directly; a 404 payload also includes a {detail} string. Current catch sets a generic 'This video doesn’t exist or was removed.' which is fine, but any transient 5xx also shows the same message. Consider distinguishing network vs 404.

Studio.jsx: the 'Surprise me' handler filters by exact prompt string equality (pool.filter((i) => i.prompt !== prompt)); if the user edits the prompt manually the duplicate guard no longer helps. Minor.
